title: International Summer School for Young Physicists
text:
The ISSYP is an exciting and challenging two-week program for Canadian and international high school students with a keen interest in theoretical physics and who intend to pursue physics studies at the university level held each summer at Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada.

Admission[edit]

In order to apply to the ISSYP, applicants must:

  • Have a strong interest in physics and intend to pursue physics at the university level.
  • Be in 11th or 12 grade (last two years of secondary school).
  • Have not gone on to post-secondary education(college or university).

Program[edit]

The program at ISSYP involves:

  • Lectures on various topics of modern physics
  • The ability to work with researchers at the Perimeter Institute.
  • Hands-on Labs
